# jenkins_jobs (Data Source)

Lists the names of the jobs directly within a Jenkins folder (or the root).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "jenkins_jobs" "root" {}

data "jenkins_jobs" "in_folder" {
  folder = "my-folder"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `folder` (String) The folder to list jobs from. If not set, the Jenkins root is listed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The folder whose jobs are listed, or `/` for the root.
- `jobs` (Set of String) The names of the jobs (excluding folders) directly within the folder.
